fields.description: District 11 Opal Gardens is a gated villa and townhouse community in Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City. Originally marketed under Meydan, it appears in Nakheel’s document collection and in its project consultant’s portfolio. Homes include four-bedroom townhouses and semi-detached residences, alongside four- to six-bedroom standalone villas.
amenities: Crystal lagoon and sandy beach areas

overview: The community is arranged around a lagoon and landscaped recreation spaces, with cycling routes and facilities for outdoor activity. Its home types vary substantially in footprint, number of levels and service spaces. Built-up measurements include components beyond enclosed living rooms, so a specific layout is more useful than a project-wide size average.
research.locationNote: The documents place Opal Gardens in District 11, Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City, near the Al Ain Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road corridors. No exact existing neighbourhood mapping is used; District 11 is absent from the current catalogue.
research.priceNote: Tanami publishes an original starting reference of AED 4.2m. Property Finder’s present project headline instead shows AED 16m; that selected catalogue figure does not replace the original entry-level guide or establish current available inventory. Obtain the actual home’s resale or developer quotation.
research.paymentNote: Binayah reports the historical schedule as 10% booking; 10% on each of 30 April 2023, 30 October 2023, 30 April 2024 and 30 October 2024; 5% on 30 April 2025; 5% on 30 October 2025; and 40% handover. Property Finder independently gives the same aggregate 10/ 50/ 40. This is not a current resale payment offer; outstanding balances and charges need confirmation.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder retains an anticipated September 2026 completion. FazWaz reports completion in July 2026, while the project consultant describes delivery without a dated unit-level handover record. These public references do not establish the current completion or occupancy status of every home; no single confirmed headline date is assigned.

facts.label: Area and optional works
facts.value: The plans include garages and specified terraces within built-up area. Their disclaimers say landscaping, pools and annex illustrations are not standard inclusions; pool/annex options may carry an additional charge.

facts.label: Development scale
facts.value: Hill International identifies 435 residential units and Nakheel Properties as its client. This is the development scope, not a count of homes available to buy.
